name: Edna
source:
A Brightleaf Elf wizard who has left her forest and is in Ishgalia for a specific purpose. She is extremely miserly and will not pass up the chance to earn money if she can help it. Shortly after meeting Claudia Azure, they form a party together to explore the dungeons below Ishgalia. 

[Spoiler] Her full name is Edna Yellimagot, the queen-in-waiting of the Yellimagot forest community of Brightleaf elves. Having discovered her race is slowly moving towards extinction and discovering all efforts to reverse this decline internally have failed, she chooses to leave the forest despite the objections of elders to seek a solution to the problem in human society. For this reason she is unpopular amongst certain sectors of the Yellimagot elves for having apparently abandoned her responsibilities as princess. Although her mother ultimately accepted her decision to leave, many like Nemu do not understand her true intentions. Her love of money stems partly from her materialistic desires and the urgency in which she buys important resources to send back to her forest home for research. [/Spoiler]

Her choice of outfit is aimed at facilitating her ease of movement.
